M01.constraint: The Title field must contain no more than 20 characters.

M02.constraint: The body must end with the exact text [Disclaimer].

M03.constraint: The attachment value must be exactly three comma-separated image IDs.

M04.constraint: The amount must include the CNY currency prefix.

M05.constraint: The copy must quote the property-record sentence exactly.

M06.constraint: The LanguageNote field must be written in Simplified Chinese.

M07.constraint: The copy must not contain either internal codename SEED or WAN.

M08.constraint: The copy must contain the exact call to action Book a viewing now.

M09.constraint: The time value must use ISO 8601 format.

M10.constraint: The phone number must mask its middle four digits.

M11.constraint: The copy must contain no more than one emoji.
